name: Investment
overview: Scripture teaches that wise investment involves patience and diligent labor, as seen in Leviticus 19:23 where fruit from newly planted trees is not to be eaten for three years, emphasizing careful stewardship. Prosperity comes from meditating on and obeying God's law, which leads to success (Joshua 1:8). Proverbs highlights that wealth gained hastily or by vanity will diminish, but wealth accumulated through honest labor will grow (Proverbs 13:11). Additionally, the relationship between lender and borrower is one of authority and servitude, underscoring the importance of prudent financial decisions (Proverbs 22:7). Ultimately, God’s blessing enables the possession of an inheritance free from poverty (Deuteronomy 15:4).
